rows.description: Your computers, working as one. Share keyboard, mouse, trackpad, clipboard, drag and drop and audio across Macs and PCs.
One keyboard and mouse for a Mac and a Windows PC over the local network, in either direction.

All your computers and your phone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux and Android. Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and now no shared network needed.
